result_text:
I changed the two mock-folder rules in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/scoping/TestConventions.java` (lines 75–76). The convention tests in `codeanalyzer` pass, but I didn't add tests for the new cases or check them by hand. So `mock`, `mock.data`, `mock(old)`, `mock-größe` and `mock模拟` are not yet confirmed as test code.

The patterns were `.*/__mock[a-zA-Z0-9_\- ]+/.*` and `.*/mock[a-zA-Z0-9_\- ]+/.*`. They required at least one ASCII letter, digit, `_`, `-` or space after `mock`. That is why a plain `mock/` folder, punctuation like `.` or `(`, and non-ASCII characters were all missed. They are now `.*/__mock[^/]*/.*` and `.*/mock[^/]*/.*`, so anything after `mock` or `__mock` counts, as long as it stays within that one folder name.

- **Previously matched folders:** `mocks/`, `__mocks__/`, `mock-data/`, `mock_data/`, `mock data/` and `mockStore/` still match.
- **Folders that should not match:** `remock/` and `demo/` don't, because the folder name must start with `mock`. Files named `mock.java` or `mockery.java` don't, because the pattern needs a `/` right after the folder name.
- **Backslash paths:** `SourceFileFilter.pathMatches` already tries slash-normalised variants of the path, so Windows-style paths work without any change there.
